packet.headline_seed: Corgi, the buzzy Y Combinator-backed insurance tech startup, says it didn’t steal an open source product
packet.description_seed: Corgi became embroiled in controversy when Papermark accused it of stealing its software. Corgi says it did not, raising new questions about vibe coding.
